data.text: [00:04]Hi Marcos, what are you doing next Thursday? `[00:08]And your brother too ... is he around?
[00:11.6]Erm ... next Thursday? `[00:14]Ermm ... my brother is staying with friends next week ... but I’m not doing anything. Why?
[00:22]Well, I’m having a meal at my house to celebrate Thanksgiving and I’d really like you to come.
[00:29.6]Oh, thanks, I’d love to! `[00:32]That’s very kind of you!
